A Japanese DIY enthusiast has made that a reality News By Si Truss Published 3 October 2024 The Arduino-powered ‘Key-bowed’ is built around an adapted Roland MIDI keyboard Share Share this article Join the conversation Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter YouTube Watch On In recent years we’ve seen a variety of new technologies that aim to offer a more expressive synth playing experience than you’d get with a traditional keyboard. Orac is essentially an open source virtual studio that lets you create and save patches, using a wide variety of modules. Orac makes it much easier to create deep patches on the Organelle and to make use of the power of the Organelle’s hardware. Patch building is done without needing to code, by way of using the Organelle’s existing hardware (keys and encoder). Pricing and Availability The Organelle M is available now for US $595.
